subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: Stripe: Payments in Seven Lines
description: A micro-lesson that makes Stripe: Payments in Seven Lines usable.

hook.text: Processing credit cards on the web used to require a merchant account and weeks of paperwork.

buildup.text: Patrick and John Collison built Stripe so developers could accept payments in seven lines of code.

discovery.text: Stripe handled fraud detection, compliance, and global currencies behind a simple API.

twist.text: Two brothers from rural Ireland built a $95 billion company that powers internet commerce.

climax.text: Stripe made online payments invisible. Millions of businesses run on it without users knowing.

punchline.text: Seven lines of code unlocked global commerce.
